# NEAR AI

> Documentation for NEAR AI Cloud: private, verifiable AI inference in Trusted Execution Environments through an OpenAI-compatible API.

- [Private. Intelligent. Yours.](https://docs.near.ai/index.md): Build private, user-owned AI with NEAR AI Cloud
- [Quickstart](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/quickstart.md)
- [Available Models](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/models.md): Explore NEAR AI Cloud model catalog
- [Reasoning Models](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/reasoning-models.md): Learn how to enable and disable reasoning capabilities for supported models
- [Private Inference](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/private-inference.md): Learn how NEAR AI Cloud's private inference leverages TEEs to provide cryptographically verifiable AI computations with complete data privacy and security.
- [Staking for Inference](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/staking-for-inference/overview.md): Stake NEAR and let the staking rewards pay for private inference on NEAR AI Cloud — your principal stays yours and stays withdrawable.
- [Staking Calculator](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/staking-for-inference/calculator.md): Estimate how much NEAR to stake to cover your private inference usage, or see what a given stake gets you — based on the current NEAR price and staking APY.
- [Verification](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/index.md): Verify requests sent through the NEAR AI Cloud Gateway.
- [Verification Center](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/verification-center.md): Check a model's hardware attestation and a reply's signature in your browser, without writing code.
- [Gateway Attestation](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/cloud-api/gateway-attestation.md): Verify the NEAR AI Cloud gateway attestation for requests sent to cloud-api.near.ai.
- [NEAR Model Attestations](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/cloud-api/model-attestations.md): Verify the NEAR model-attestation report returned through the NEAR AI Cloud gateway.
- [TLS Connection Binding](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/cloud-api/tls.md): Bind a live NEAR AI Cloud gateway TLS connection to the gateway attestation.
- [Response Signatures](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/cloud-api/response-signatures.md): Verify available response signatures from the NEAR AI Cloud gateway against exact bytes and matching preflight evidence.
- [Image Provenance](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/cloud-api/image-provenance.md): Apply an image-provenance policy to configurations measured in NEAR AI Cloud gateway and model attestations.
- [Quote, Nonce, and Signer Bindings](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/reference/quote-nonce-signer.md): Shared rules for reading verified quotes, checking freshness, and matching signing identities.
- [Response Signature Verification](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/reference/response-signature-verification.md): Verify a response signature over exact request and response bytes.
- [Verification Policy](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/verification/reference/verification-policy.md): Define required evidence, acceptable measurements, provenance requirements, and handling for unavailable verification results.
- [SDK](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/inference-sdk/index.md): Call NEAR AI Cloud inference and verify responses in JavaScript, Python, Rust, and Go.
- [JavaScript](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/inference-sdk/javascript.md): Use the JavaScript SDK for verified Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, and System One decisions.
- [Python](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/inference-sdk/python.md): Use the asynchronous Python SDK for verified Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, and System One decisions.
- [Rust](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/inference-sdk/rust.md): Use the Rust SDK for verified Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, and System One decisions.
- [Go](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/inference-sdk/go.md): Use the Go SDK for verified Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, and System One decisions.
- [Embedded](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/inference-sdk/widget/embedded.md): Embed the Verification Center and supply your application's verification reports.
- [OpenAI Compatibility](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/openai-compatibility.md): How to use NEAR AI Cloud with standard OpenAI SDKs
- [Stateless Responses API](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/stateless-responses.md): Use the OpenAI Responses shape without server-side conversation or response storage
- [Usage Reporting API](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/usage-reporting.md)
- [Integrations](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/index.md): Use NEAR AI Cloud with third-party software that supports OpenAI-compatible providers.
- [Model Discovery and Refresh](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/model-discovery.md): Discover current NEAR AI Cloud models and refresh stale client model lists.
- [OpenCode](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/opencode.md): Configure OpenCode to use NEAR AI Cloud as an OpenAI-compatible provider.
- [Cursor](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/cursor.md): Configure Cursor with NEAR AI Cloud through Cursor's OpenAI API key and base URL settings.
- [Continue](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/continue.md): Configure Continue to use NEAR AI Cloud through its OpenAI-compatible provider.
- [Cline, Roo Code, and Kilo Code](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/cline-roo-kilo.md): Configure Cline, Roo Code, and Kilo Code with NEAR AI Cloud's OpenAI-compatible API.
- [Aider and Zed](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/aider-zed.md): Configure Aider and Zed to use NEAR AI Cloud as an OpenAI-compatible provider.
- [Goose](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/opencode-goose.md): Configure Goose to use NEAR AI Cloud as an OpenAI-compatible provider.
- [LibreChat](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/librechat.md): Configure LibreChat to use NEAR AI Cloud as an OpenAI-compatible custom endpoint.
- [Open WebUI](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/open-webui.md): Configure Open WebUI to use NEAR AI Cloud as an OpenAI-compatible provider.
- [LiteLLM Proxy](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/litellm.md): Configure the LiteLLM Python SDK and LiteLLM Proxy to use NEAR AI Cloud.
- [Dify](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/integrations/dify.md): Configure Dify with NEAR AI Cloud through the OpenAI-API-compatible model provider plugin.
- [Prompt Caching](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/prompt-caching.md): How NEAR AI Cloud caches prompt prefixes to reduce latency and cost
- [Web Search](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/web-search.md): Give models access to live web results with built-in web search tools
- [Embeddings, Images, Audio & More](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/specialized-endpoints.md): Use NEAR AI Cloud for embeddings, reranking, image generation, audio transcription, and PII detection — all inside TEEs
- [End-to-End Encrypted Chat Completions](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/guides/e2ee-chat-completions.md): How to use end-to-end encryption for chat completions with NEAR AI Cloud
- [Direct Completions](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/experimental/direct-completions.md): Experimental: send requests straight to one self-hosted model's TEE endpoint, without the NEAR AI Cloud Gateway.
- [SDK](https://docs.near.ai/cloud/inference-sdk/direct.md): Experimental SDK notes for direct model endpoints.
- [API Reference](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/introduction.md): OpenAI-compatible REST API for private, verifiable AI inference on NEAR AI Cloud
- [Create chat completion](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/chat/create-chat-completion.md): Generate AI model responses for chat conversations. Supports both streaming and non-streaming modes. OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [Create text completion](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/chat/create-text-completion.md): Generate AI model responses for text prompts. OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [List available models](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/chat/list-available-models.md): Returns all AI models available for completions. OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [Create response](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/responses/create-response.md): Generate a single-turn, stateless AI response with optional streaming.
- [List models with pricing](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/models/list-models-with-pricing.md): Get all available models with pricing information. Public endpoint.
- [Get model details](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/models/get-model-details.md): Get pricing and metadata for a specific model. URL-encode model names containing slashes. Public endpoint.
- [Edit images from a text prompt and image](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/images/edit-images-from-a-text-prompt-and-image.md): Edit images using an AI model from an image and text description. OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [Generate images from text prompt](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/images/generate-images-from-text-prompt.md): Generate images using an AI model from a text description. OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [Audio transcription endpoint](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/audio/audio-transcription-endpoint.md): Transcribe audio files using Whisper models. Accepts audio file uploads via multipart/form-data. Supports MP3, WAV, WEBM, FLAC, OGG, and M4A formats. Maximum file size: 25 MB.
- [Document reranking endpoint](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/rerank/document-reranking-endpoint.md): Ranks documents by relevance to a query using a reranker model.
- [Text similarity scoring endpoint](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/score/text-similarity-scoring-endpoint.md): Scores the similarity between two texts using a scoring/ranking model.
- [Post v1privacyclassify](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/privacy/post-v1privacyclassify.md)
- [Post v1privacyredact](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/privacy/post-v1privacyredact.md)
- [Get Intel Trust Authority attestation token](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/attestation/get-intel-trust-authority-attestation-token.md): Get Intel Trust Authority signed attestation JWTs for the gateway and, when requested, compatible model provider evidence. Public endpoint — this is an explicit, documented decision (nearai/infra#193): the response carries only ITA-signed TEE evidence (no customer or key-scoped data), public access…
- [Which attested backup-provider trust inputs are live](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/attestation/which-attested-backup-provider-trust-inputs-are-live.md): Public endpoint, a deliberate and documented exception like `/v1/attestation/ita-token` (see `build_public_attestation_routes` in `routes/attestation.rs`). The body is an object keyed by provider name (`tinfoil`, `chutes`). Each section lists the provider's compiled pins and any runtime trust it acc…
- [Get attestation report](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/attestation/get-attestation-report.md): Get hardware attestation report for TEE verification. The API key is optional, so a client can verify the gateway before it sends any credential. Without a key, listed models only; with one, also the unlisted models the key's organization may use. A key that is sent must be valid. Report retrieval i…
- [Get completion or Responses API signature](https://docs.near.ai/api-reference/attestation/get-completion-or-responses-api-signature.md): Get a cryptographic signature for a chat completion or completed stateless `resp_*` response. Returns signature data on success, or an unavailable response if a chat-completion stream was disconnected.
